name: Grounding Bolt
reqs: 90s LTN, 90r LHT OR 90r MED OR 90r HVY
additional_info: 10 second cooldown. Procs on lightning strikes caused from Scorched Peak, Fulgurite Formation, the Specialist Set equipment Talents, and Storm/Stormbreaker enchantments during the rain.
desc: Anytime you summon a lightning strike on your opponent, disable their ability to jump. Uppercutting your opponent while they are unable to jump now strikes them with another bolt of lightning.
